key_expressions: Please take a look at the file when you can,
Let me know if you need anything else,
Could we adjust the schedule if needed?,
I'll wait for your feedback after the review,

A: Hello! Do you have a moment to talk?
Most of the updates you requested have been applied.
I'll send you the draft file now.
B: Yes, I’m available. What’s it about?
Oh, nice! Which parts were updated?
Sounds good. I’ll check it and get back to you.

A: Were you able to review the previous file?
I revised the wording so it sounds more natural.
If you want, I can prepare a second version as well.
B: Yes, I went through it!
Oh, that part is much clearer now.
Great. Please go ahead with the next step.

A: The additional table you requested will be done today.
I also adjusted the structure so the data flow is easier to see.
Please review that part as well, if possible.
B: Wow, thank you. That was fast!
Nice. I’m especially curious about the structural changes.
Sure, I’ll review it and send feedback soon.

A: Would it be possible to adjust the schedule a bit?
After checking internally, it seems we need an extra day.
Sorry for the inconvenience.
B: Yes, we still have some flexibility, so it's fine.
I see. That makes sense if more time is needed.
Go ahead. As long as we meet the final deadline, it’s no problem.

A: Could you take a look at the updated design?
I matched the colors and layout to your preferences.
If you'd like a version with a different tone, I can create one.
B: Oh, I’ll check it now!
Yes, it looks much cleaner and easier to view.
Great. I’d like to compare it with another tone as well.

A: Is this the part you wanted to emphasize in your feedback?
I revised that section so the message is much clearer.
If you have more suggestions, I can update it right away.
B: Yes, that’s exactly the part!
It’s definitely clearer now.
Perfect. Please continue in that direction.

A: The file size increased a little. Is that okay?
It happened because I tried to keep the image quality high.
If you need, I can also make an optimized version.
B: Ah, I see. That’s fine!
Keeping the quality is more important.
But yes, having an optimized version would be helpful too.

A: Would you like a short summary before the meeting?
I can create a one-page version that works well for presentations.
If you want, I can prepare it right away.
B: Oh, that would be really helpful!
A one-page summary would make the meeting prep much easier.
Yes, please. I’ll review it once you share it.

A: Were you able to open the file I sent yesterday?
I was worried there might be compatibility issues.
If needed, I can convert it to another format as well.
B: Yes, it opened just fine! No issues.
Thank you for checking.
Another format could be useful later, but this one works for now.

A: We plan to deliver the final version within this week.
Once the internal review is done, I’ll send it immediately.
Please let me know if the deadline needs to be adjusted.
B: Great, thanks for the update!
Once the internal review is finished, it’s basically done then.
Got it. I’ll inform you right away if anything changes.
